pinyin: xiàng yǔ zá guō —— pò fǔ chén zhōu
literal: Xiang Yu · smash · cooking pot — break · cauldrons · sink · boats
natural: Xiang Yu smashes the cooking pots

meaning.en: Cutting off all retreat and committing fully.
meaning.zh: 项羽渡河后砸锅沉船，表示不留退路、决一死战。

examples.zh: 项羽砸锅，这次我们没有退路了。
examples.en: Like Xiang Yu smashing his pots, we have no way back this time.

examples.zh: 他辞职创业，真是项羽砸锅。
examples.en: He quit his job to start a business, burning his boats.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The punchline is the chengyu 破釜沉舟.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句即成语“破釜沉舟”。

text: 乡下人穿西装——土洋结合
pinyin: xiāng xià rén chuān xī zhuāng —— tǔ yáng jié hé
literal: country · person · wear · Western suit — local · foreign · combine
natural: A villager in a Western suit: a mix of rustic and foreign

meaning.en: A mismatched blend of the rustic and the modern.
meaning.zh: 土气和洋气混在一起，形容搭配不协调或土洋并用。

examples.zh: 乡下人穿西装，土洋结合，倒也有点特别。
examples.en: A villager in a suit, rustic meets foreign; rather distinctive.

examples.zh: 他这身打扮真是乡下人穿西装。
examples.en: His outfit is a rustic-meets-foreign mix.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Humorous; can also describe combining traditional and modern methods.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。带幽默色彩，也可指土办法与洋办法并用。

pinyin: xiān nǚ sàn huā —— tiān huā luàn zhuì
literal: fairy · scatter · flowers — heaven · flowers · chaotic · fall

meaning.zh: 仙女散花时花瓣漫天飘落，比喻说话夸张动听却不可靠。

examples.zh: 仙女散花，他把这个项目说得天花乱坠。
examples.en: He made the project sound wonderful in the most glowing terms.

examples.zh: 别听销售员仙女散花地吹。
examples.en: Don't listen to the salesman's lavish patter.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The punchline is the chengyu 天花乱坠.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句即成语“天花乱坠”。

text: 下雨天背棉絮——越背越重
pinyin: xià yǔ tiān bēi mián xù —— yuè bēi yuè zhòng
literal: rainy · day · carry · cotton wadding — the more · carry · the more · heavy
natural: Carrying cotton wadding in the rain gets heavier and heavier

meaning.en: A burden that only grows heavier the longer you carry it.
meaning.zh: 棉絮淋雨吸水，越背越沉，比喻负担或包袱越来越重。

examples.zh: 下雨天背棉絮，这笔债越背越重。
examples.en: That debt is a growing burden.

examples.zh: 心里的包袱像下雨天背棉絮，越背越重。
examples.en: The worry weighs more the longer I carry it.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Used of debts, worries and responsibilities.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。多用于债务、心事、责任等。

pinyin: xiā zi shè jiàn —— wú dì fàng shǐ
literal: blind man · shoot · arrows — no · target · loose · arrow

meaning.en: Speaking or acting aimlessly, with no real target.
meaning.zh: 瞎子看不见靶子，乱射一气，比喻说话做事没有针对性。

examples.zh: 瞎子射箭，你这样批评是无的放矢。
examples.en: Your criticism is aimless, like shooting in the dark.

examples.zh: 没做调查就发表意见，简直是瞎子射箭。
examples.en: Giving opinions with no research is like a blind man shooting arrows.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The punchline is the chengyu 无的放矢.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句即成语“无的放矢”。

text: 瞎子拜见丈人——有眼不识泰山
pinyin: xiā zi bài jiàn zhàng rén —— yǒu yǎn bù shí tài shān
variants: 瞎子拜见岳父——有眼不识泰山
literal: blind man · pay respects to · father-in-law — have · eyes · not · recognise · Mount Tai
natural: A blind man meeting his father-in-law

meaning.en: Failing to recognise an important person in front of you.
meaning.zh: 瞎子认不出丈人，比喻面对重要人物却认不出来。

examples.zh: 瞎子拜见丈人，真是有眼不识泰山，失敬了！
examples.en: I didn't recognise a master when I saw one; forgive me!

examples.zh: 原来您就是王教授，我真是瞎子拜见丈人。
examples.en: So you are Professor Wang; I should have known.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Used humorously as self-deprecation on discovering someone's status.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。常作自嘲，用于发现对方身份显赫时。

text: 捂着耳朵偷铃铛——自己骗自己
pinyin: wǔ zhe ěr duo tōu líng dāng —— zì jǐ piàn zì jǐ
literal: cover · ears · steal · bell — oneself · deceive · oneself
natural: Stealing a bell while covering one's ears

meaning.en: Deceiving oneself by ignoring the obvious.
meaning.zh: 捂住耳朵就以为别人听不见，比喻自欺欺人。

equivalents: bury one's head in the sand

examples.zh: 捂着耳朵偷铃铛，你以为没人知道吗？
examples.en: Do you think nobody knows, like a man covering his ears to steal a bell?

examples.zh: 他这是捂着耳朵偷铃铛，自己骗自己。
examples.en: He is just fooling himself.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Based on the fable 掩耳盗铃.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。源自寓言“掩耳盗铃”。

text: 西施掉了门牙——美中不足
pinyin: xī shī diào le mén yá —— měi zhōng bù zú
literal: Xi Shi · lose · front tooth — beauty · within · not · enough
natural: Xi Shi has lost a front tooth

meaning.en: A small flaw in an otherwise fine thing.
meaning.zh: 绝色美人掉了门牙，比喻很好的事物中有一点缺陷。

examples.zh: 房子很漂亮，就是离地铁远，真是西施掉了门牙。
examples.en: The house is lovely but far from the metro: one small blemish.

examples.zh: 这次演出西施掉了门牙，灯光出了问题。
examples.en: The show was fine apart from the faulty lighting.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. The punchline is the chengyu 美中不足.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。后半句即成语“美中不足”。

text: 西瓜皮揩屁股——一塌糊涂
pinyin: xī guā pí kāi pì gu —— yī tā hú tu
literal: watermelon · rind · wipe · backside — one · collapse · muddle · muddle
natural: Wiping one's backside with watermelon rind

meaning.zh: 西瓜皮揩屁股弄得一团糟，比喻乱得不成样子。

examples.zh: 西瓜皮揩屁股，这个房间乱得一塌糊涂。
examples.en: This room is an utter mess.

examples.zh: 他的账目西瓜皮揩屁股，没人理得清。
examples.en: His accounts are a shambles that nobody can sort out.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Earthy humour; informal.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。口语，较粗俗诙谐。

text: 武大郎攀杠子——上不着天，下不着地
pinyin: wǔ dà láng pān gàng zi —— shàng bù zháo tiān, xià bù zháo dì
literal: Wu Dalang · cling to · pole — up · not · reach · sky, down · not · reach · ground
natural: Wu Dalang dangling from a pole

meaning.en: Stuck in between, neither up nor down.
meaning.zh: 武大郎个子矮，攀杠悬在半空，比喻处境尴尬、两头够不着。

examples.zh: 武大郎攀杠子，我现在上不着天，下不着地。
examples.en: I'm stuck in between, neither up nor down.

examples.zh: 工作不上不下，真像武大郎攀杠子。
examples.en: My job is stuck in limbo.

usage.en: Usually only the first half is said, and the listener supplies the rest. Casual and humorous. Wu Dalang is the short husband of Pan Jinlian in 《水浒传》.
usage.zh: 通常只说前半句，后半句由听者领会。口语，带诙谐色彩。武大郎是《水浒传》中身材矮小的人物。
